verdict.rationale: Asana documents event-driven automation through rule actions, webhooks, the API, and AI Studio no-code automations, and lists third-party automation tools such as Zapier, n8n, and Pipedream. None of the evidence shows a native scheduled or recurring trigger, so time-based workflows appear to need an external scheduler or integration. Missing for 10: documented native schedule/recurring triggers for rules or AI Studio, details on how recurring workflows are configured, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
